Online Bureau & Dado Ruvic

NEW DELHI: Brookfield has agreed to acquire a 100% interest in a 10.5 million sq ft industrial and logistics portfolio from ESR India , marking its maiden entry into the segment in India.

As part of the transaction, it has committed ₹4,300 crore, or about $450 million, towards the acquisition and future development of the portfolio. ESR will continue to manage the properties in the near term.

The portfolio is spread across approximately 400 acres and comprises eight Grade A industrial and logistics parks across six metro clusters, including Mumbai, Pune, Delhi-NCR, Chennai and Kolkata.

The operating portfolio is around 98% leased and houses a mix of logistics and industrial occupiers across light manufacturing, fulfilment centres and warehousing.

Ankur Gupta , deputy chief investment officer and head of Asia Pacific and Middle East-real estate at Brookfield, said the acquisition expands the company’s Indian real estate portfolio beyond office and hospitality into logistics and industrial assets.

Brookfield currently has more than $13 billion of real estate assets in India across office and hospitality, including Brookfield India Real Estate Trust and Leela Palaces Hotels and Resorts.

The company has approximately $33 billion of assets under management in India across infrastructure, energy, private equity, real estate and credit.
